Etherfuse CETES Stablebond disclosure (current maturity and INDEVAL custody)

reserveReview.rationale: Brale's MXNe launch disclosure identifies the Etherfuse partnership; Etherfuse's current CETES page identifies the token as Mexican federal CETES with approximately seven-day maturities and INDEVAL custody; and BHR México's June 26, 2026 reasonable-assurance examination reconciles Etherfuse token commitments to bank/investment assets, including the CETES program at MXN 98,013,671 against MXN 92,643,402.94 token value (105.80%). The report names BBVA México, Casa de Bolsa BASE, and Actinver as reserve institutions. MXNe-specific liability and sub-portfolio balances remain undisclosed, so the 100% slice is a category/dependency classification, not an MXNe balance claim.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Brale MXNe product disclosure plus Etherfuse CETES disclosure and BHR México assets-and-liabilities reasonable-assurance examination
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The tracked CETES reserve dependency is identified at 100%; MXNe-specific reserve balances, liability reconciliation, and the MXNe sub-portfolio split within Etherfuse are not separately disclosed.
